title: Surf Mar
thumbnail_desc: Study for the Renovation and Expansion of the Surf Mar Hotel in Costa Brava.
description: In colaboration wit Col.9067 The building embodies the company’s image, making it distinctive among other offerings. Designed to inspire guests to enjoy its facilities, it features a landscaped roof entrance, a 15-meter-high lobby, staggered terraces, a ceramic façade, and carefully planned parking and sports areas. The ceramic skin gives warmth to the guestroom façade, separates quiet leisure areas from sports zones, creates a striking visual impact, and contributes to the building’s energy efficiency.
